annotations.title: List saved goals for this memory

description: The saved goals this office already asked Mitosis to pull out of data. Call this before choosing enrichment on a new source so you can offer those goals (the user can pick several) instead of inventing a new one. Last-used goals are first. Then pass the chosen ids as goal_ids to cortex_choose_enrichment.
name: cortex_list_goals
